name: ZBP Source Code to AI Baseline
description: Zscaler Best Practice baseline that blocks uploads of Python, JavaScript and shell-script source code to AI/ML applications. The rule's application scope is resolved from the tenant's AI_ML cloud-application catalogue at deploy time, so applications Zscaler classifies later are covered on the next deploy. Immutable: objects that drift from this definition are restored. The rule ENFORCES (BLOCK); deploy in a pilot scope first if you need to tune the dictionaries.
references: Zscaler Best Practices: Data Protection for Generative AI
